admission.justification: A half-prepared host that reports nothing leaves the user with a daemon and a broken install and no way to tell which; the cases pin the stage and the retained effects.

applicability: Any failed first-run preparation, provisioning or plug-in load response.
conditions: The response names the stage that failed and every effect already completed.
A daemon left running is reported rather than hidden.
exclusions: Successful answers, which report the seat instead.
statement: Every failed preparation response identifies its stage, all prior partial effects and any daemon left running.
